summary: TriCo Bancshares filed an 8-K to announce a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.36 per share, payable June 26, 2026, to holders of record June 5, 2026. This is a standard capital return event with no special-situation implications; the dividend is consistent with prior quarters (147th consecutive quarterly dividend). No advisory roles, premiums, or deal structures are present. Watch for any future changes in dividend policy or capital allocation strategy, but no risk-arb angle exists.
